panels.title: Max Chunk Pollution
panels.description: Dashed lines: smog 500k, poison 750k, vegetation 1M, sour rain 2M (GT defaults)

panels.title: Ingots in Storage
panels.description: Ingots in chests, drawers and machine slots, summed over every mod's version of the same ingot

panels.title: Leaderboard: Items Stored
panels.description: Every item in the containers of a team's claimed chunks

panels.title: Allocated and Freed
panels.description: Freed is allocation minus how fast the heap grows: what the garbage collector reclaimed per second

panels.title: GC Time per Second
panels.description: Share of wall clock time spent in garbage collection, young pauses are stop the world

panels.title: Tick Time
panels.description: 50 ms is the budget for 20 TPS

panels.title: Chunk Loads and Unloads per Second
Population Time
panels.description: Share of server time spent populating chunks, exclusive of nested populations. wall minus cpu is waiting (locks, disk, GC). The bars on the right axis should stay at 0: frame mismatches are Pre/Post events that didn't pair up (the unpaired frames' own time is left out, the frame that did pair has the strays' elapsed time removed, but their made up end cuts into its own time, so it counts as approximate: a lower bound), cpu unavailable are populations whose CPU time couldn't be read

panels.title: Population per Chunk
panels.description: Wall time per populated chunk, exclusive of nested populations. slowest is the largest single exclusive time, not end-to-end latency

panels.title: Steam Production
panels.description: L per second (1 L = 1 mB) from Railcraft and GregTech boilers, as of the last world save. GT solar boilers aren't included, their output depends on sunlight

panels.title: Oil Stored
panels.description: mB of oil in tanks and machines in claimed chunks

panels.title: Steam Stored
panels.description: mB of steam in boilers, tanks and pipes

panels.title: Steam Production per Boiler
panels.description: L per second. Railcraft: every cycle (8 ticks high pressure, 16 low) a boiling boiler (heat at least 100) turns tanks x heat / 500 water into 160 times as much steam, as far as its water lasts. GregTech: full rate above 100 degrees with water (Small Coal 120, High Pressure Coal 300, Lava 600). Solar boilers are left out

panels.title: Boiler Heat and Temperature
panels.description: Railcraft heat boils from 100 (max 500 low pressure, 1000 high), GregTech boilers make steam above 100 degrees

panels.title: Fluids Stored
panels.description: mB per fluid in tile entities of claimed chunks (tanks, machines, pipes)

panels.title: Boiler Fuel
panels.description: Items in each boiler's inventory (fuel waiting, GregTech ash, a Railcraft liquid firebox's containers) and liquid firebox fuel tanks

targets.expr: sum by (item, x, y, z) (railcraft_boiler_fuel_items{alias="$alias",team=~"$team"}) or sum by (item, x, y, z, boiler) (gt_boiler_fuel_items{alias="$alias",team=~"$team"})

panels.title: Creosote from Coke Ovens
panels.description: mB per second, from the coke oven recipes for what each oven is cooking

panels.title: GregTech Machines
panels.description: As of the last world save. Progress is ticks into the current recipe over its length

panels.title: Being Made
panels.description: What each running GregTech machine's current recipe will produce

panels.title: Coke Ovens
panels.description: Batch length, and coke and creosote per second, come from Railcraft's coke oven recipe for each oven's input

targets.expr: max by (input, output, x, y, z) (railcraft_coke_oven_cooking{alias="$alias",team=~"$team"})
max by (input, output, x, y, z) (railcraft_coke_oven_cook_ticks{alias="$alias",team=~"$team"} / railcraft_coke_oven_total_ticks{alias="$alias",team=~"$team"})
max by (input, output, x, y, z) (railcraft_coke_oven_output_per_second{alias="$alias",team=~"$team"})
max by (input, output, x, y, z) (railcraft_coke_oven_creosote_mb_per_second{alias="$alias",team=~"$team"})
